name: necrotide-last-stand
description: Round-based undead survival shooter for Roblox. Live-syncs into Studio with Rojo - `npm run live` also auto-pulls pushed commits - or builds a ready-to-open .rbxlx place and a drag-in .rbxmx model from plain Luau sources.

scripts.setup: node tools/sync.js install && node tools/sync.js plugin && node tools/sync.js doctor
scripts.all: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify && npm run test && npm run test:sync && npm run doctor
